variantsAndExceptions.name: OptionPayout.payerReceiver inversion
variantsAndExceptions.description: Several examples show payer/receiver values that appear inverted relative to FPML buyer/seller; mapping direction may differ or be intentionally inverted in CDM.
variantsAndExceptions.impactOnGeneralization: Mapping of buyer/seller to payer/receiver should be treated as a variant; automated rules should include a verification step. This reduces confidence in blindly swapping roles without checking contextual semantics.
